items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:71:1
items.html: But the VAK [six ends] of the Bina of MA, together with the Malchut of the Bina of MA, which are YESHSUT, resemble ZON and are not joined in as great a union as AVI: Because there is a great difference between the upper AVI, who are from the Chazeh [chest] of AA and upward, and YESHSUT, who are from the Chazeh of AA and downward, as above in the adjacent item, study it there well. And therefore the MA and BON in them do not join together very much, as above in the ARI’s words (page 663, item 65), that the more the Partzufim descend from their degree, the more their separation of MA from BON is revealed in them. See there in the Inner Light. And it was already explained above that YESHSUT resemble ZON, since they are the discernments of AHP that came out outside the Rosh together with ZON, study it there well.
